title: Synthetic retained heap after equal work cycles
method: Invented comparable post-collection observations grow by 120 MiB per cycle. If 60,000 entries are added per cycle, 120 × 1,048,576 / 60,000 ≈ 2,097 bytes per entry is only an attribution hypothesis; other retention can contribute.
alt: Synthetic retained heap after equal work cycles. Cycle one: 300 MiB; Cycle two: 420 MiB; Cycle three: 540 MiB. Illustrative inputs.
